description.narrative: ? Analyze the loan-level and portfolio-level data collected during the loan registration process and annual financial benchmarking ? Design research question for Aceli's financial incentives program, co-design an evaluation approach with Aceli, and implement the evaluation ? Conduct literature review on relevant findings linked to the financial incentives and technical assistance programs ? Manage a commissioning process to identify and support research that is relevant to Aceli’s learning priorities related to agricultural SME finance and related topical areas (eg, women’s economic empowerment, climate adaptation) in East Africa ? Develop research questions for Aceli's technical assistance program, co-design an evaluation approach with Aceli, and pilot with Aceli Africa Management Institute to inform the design of an evaluation ? Actively engage stakeholders (i.e., lenders, TA providers, the research community, policymakers, and other ecosystem actors)
